title: Normal and periodic tracking area updating procedure

entities.name: Normal and periodic tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to update its tracking area information with the network, including both normal updates and periodic updates required by the network.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept tracking area update request.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: Update type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of tracking area update (normal or periodic).

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identifier used to identify the UE.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: List of tracking area identities where the UE is registered.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: T3412
entities.description: Timer used for periodic tracking area updating.

relations.description: Procedure starts with UE sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
Procedure continues with network sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
Procedure completes with UE sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains update type information element.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains GUTI identifier.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains TAI list information element.
Procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
Procedure starts T3412 timer for periodic tracking area updating.
